data.name: Emma
data.gender_notes: Emma is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic ermen, 'whole, universal', a short form of names such as Ermengarde. Its root is Germanic ermen. A common Christian name in Europe since the medieval period. Emma is a Germanic name meaning “Whole; universal”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emma expresses “Whole; universal”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Germanic ermen, 'whole, universal', a short form of names such as Ermengarde.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emma total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
